hero.label: About · The Salon Lounge
hero.title: A lounge built for *considered* care.
hero.lede: Essentia — The Salon Lounge is a premium unisex salon in Attapur, Hyderabad, bringing hair, skin, grooming, nails and makeup together in one calm, well-lit space.
hero.imageAlt: Guest relaxing at the backwash while a stylist rinses her hair

story.label: Our story
story.title: Where craft meets *comfort*.
body: Our name is a promise: essential care, done exceptionally. From everyday cuts to Hydrafacials, microblading and bridal journeys, every service is delivered with the same quiet standard — no average finishes.
Guests come for the craft and stay for the atmosphere: soft seating, thoughtful lighting and a team that listens before it styles.
story.pullQuote: A team that listens before it styles.
story.imageAlt: Amber bottles of professional hair and skin care
story.secondaryImageAlt: Essentia lounge detail with arched gold mirrors and white vanities

mission.label: Our promise
mission.title: We don’t do average, *we do awesome.*
mission.lead: Quality products, skilled hands and a lounge experience that respects your time.
points: Unisex expertise across hair, skin and grooming
